verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents strong evaluation primitives—creating datasets, defining evaluators (code rules, LLM-as-judge, human review), and running experiments programmatically (langsmith-docs-7/8/9/19/25/26/27)—which are the building blocks needed to run evals in a CI pipeline. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions, pytest plugin, exit codes) or of gating/blocking deployments on eval results, so the specific 'in CI, gate deployments' workflow is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration examples, evidence of deployment-gating/pass-fail thresholds tied to eval results, independent corroboration of CI usage.
